fishing: WHEN: Friday Oct 2, storms later (about 59% after 2p) — pass and beach early. Boca Grande high 3:19a, low 12:49p; best moving water ~7–9a. Charlotte Harbor snook season open (slot 28–33, 1/day) through Nov 30; gag closed. PASSES-BEACH: Stump Pass islands holding reds and snook; a few Spanish just outside the pass (Fishin Franks 9/4–9/18). LEMON BAY: smaller black drum and big redfish under docks, pompano in the pass, trout and juvenile gags on the flats (9/25); school reds Miserable Mile to Tom Adams; snook sliding into the ICW. NEARSHORE: reefs mostly little stuff plus a few snook; mangrove, lane, and yellowtail from about 80 ft; red grouper to 26 in in 100–150 ft; permit and African pompano on wrecks. Baits: live shrimp, white bait, pinfish, cut bait.
redtide: FWC page still the Sep 25 report this morning (next update due today): K. brevis background only in SWFL (Charlotte/Lee and offshore Monroe); not observed in Sarasota. No fish kills or respiratory irritation.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD, no advisory. Manasota Key enterococci 10 on 9/28; Englewood Beach 20 CFU on 9/21 (earlier sample 10).
fpl: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 148 customers out this morning; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
